top_signals.title: Bond Investors Wary After Warsh Speech Fuels Rate-Hike Wager
top_signals.summary: Bond investors at firms including ABN AMRO Investment Solutions and Brandywine Global Investment Management are voicing skepticism about mounting speculation that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is poised to raise interest rates.

top_signals.title: Radiant World’s Senior China Trader Quits as Pressure Builds
top_signals.summary: A leading executive at Radiant World’s China office has quit, according to sources familiar with the matter, as the iron ore trader comes under pressure over concerns it provided falsified documents to banks.
